contents_mass.source: racing_game PR #22 (owner 2026-10-16: fuel and N2O bottle contents count in the car's mass, live as they are used): the chassis body carries the fuel tank and N2O bottle contents on top of its dry mass, updated whenever they moved by 0.1 kg [AS] (about 5 s of cruise or under 1 s at full throttle).

name: car_hyper_n2o
hitch_points_source: racing_game [AS]: a tow ball on the rig's socket_tow_rear (data/models/*/*.rig.json) moved to the chassis origin the way vehicle_visual.gd places the model (rig position + the mean of wheel attachment - rig wheel pivot), centred on y = 0 where the rig's recovery eye sits off centre, and RAISED in z so the ball sits at the tipper's coupler height (0.50 m above the ground at rest; ball height per car measured by rg_unit_tests [trailer_diag]): a tandem trailer on four stiff wheels is pitch-stiff, and a ball lower than its coupler makes the hitch push the nose down and lift the car's rear [M: tongue load -4.3 kN behind the saloon with the ball at 0.33 m, +0.1 kN at 0.475 m]. Ratings are assumed for the body class (braked trailer mass, tongue load = 75 kg x g for a saloon, less for the small cars); the hitch ratings never refuse a hitch, they only grade the limit findings.
source: car_hyper.json plus an ~800 hp nitrous shot (N2O plan N7, owner request 2026-10-06 'make it 800'): components n2o_bottle (../n2o_bottles/bottle_15lb_950psi.json, 15 lb at 950 psig, full) and n2o_kit (../nitrous_kits/custom_wet_plate_800_bigjet.json, 3.81/1.535 mm jets re-sized for the larger wastegate below, with its default controller ../nitrous_controllers/custom_wet_800.json - arm channel nitrous_arm, default off, progressive, 6 deg retard) and the fluid links n2o_bottle.out -> n2o_kit.n2o, n2o_kit.out -> engine.nitrous. The kit fuel is the engine's burnt fuel from the car's own tank. TURBO CHANGE [AS] (N7b, owner option b: about 800 hp at the 1.8 bar target without the wastegate saturating): the engine component carries the vehicle-level 'turbo_configuration' override ../turbo_configurations/hyper_twin_n2o.json -> ../turbos/hyper_turbo_n2o.json, the stock turbo with a 1.26 x larger wastegate (1.4875e-3 m2 per turbo instead of 1.18e-3); engines/hyper_v8_one1_audio.json, car_hyper.json and the stock turbo files are unchanged. DRIVELINE CHANGE [AS]: clutch capacity_nm 1650 -> 3650 (the shot's peak crank torque on the dyno-held V8 is about 3150 N*m at 3000 rpm, the lowest rpm of the controller's window; 1.15 x 3150 = 3622 -> 3650; the stock 1650 N*m would slip the clutch under the shot; was 3400 for the previous 3.6 mm jet with the stock gate, whose shot peak was 2950 N*m). Nothing else in the driveline is changed: gearbox synchro capacities only act while the clutch is open during a shift, the torque-following auto-clutch close takes its target from the engine's torque demand (which includes the N2O torque) plus max_sync_torque_nm, the Torsen and the park lock are not in the torque path under power; the whole-car pull in tests/validation/test_car_hyper_n2o.cpp holds the clutch locked. car_hyper source: Fictional Sculpted A hypercar, author-designed data rather than measured manufacturer specifications. Chassis mass 1500 kg, 42/58 front/rear static split, 2.70 m wheelbase, tracks 1.70/1.65 m, tyre radii 0.347/0.364 m and widths 0.265/0.325 m match the art rig. Chassis origin is the mass centre, front/rear axle x=+1.566/-1.134; the adapter shifts the complete model +0.216 m to align all four wheel arches. Chassis spawn height 0.50 m. Spring static compression 0.035 m: k=(1500*9.81*axle_fraction/2)/0.035. Attachment z=radius-0.50-0.035, so each axle settles at the correct visual ride height. Damper bump/rebound target damping ratios 0.45/0.60 about each corner mass. One:1-inspired simulated 5.1 L V8 (engines/hyper_v8_one1_audio.json, maps generated from its cycle model at load), 8250 rpm limiter; authored twin-turbo approximation with separate hardware/configuration files, cycle-generated E5 calibration producing net 1371 Nm at 6000 rpm and 1000.2 kW at 7500 rpm at ISA (assumed internals; actual E5 knock safety not validated), 7-speed assisted manual, rear drive, Torsen ratio 2.5. Tyre coefficients inherit the tested sedan model with explicit new dimensions, reference loads, stiffness and friction scales; not a measured tyre fit. Authored, uncalibrated coefficient aero: body drag/side force, splitter, bounded ground-effect underfloor and rate-limited active rear wing; fictional values, not measured One:1 aerodynamics. No suction fan fitted. Simulated engine provides live pipe-network engine audio. Fuel: authored 75 L E5 tank, initial 60 L; fuel consumption uses the simulated engine model. Game variant: generated preliminary turbo maps, with explicit authored fallback outside supported coverage; original declared power is a historical calibration, not the new dyno result. [AS] x1.3 springs, x1.14 dampers, 2026-10-12: keep the rear off the bump stop to ~450 km/h; owner report of bounce above 390 km/h. All four spring_rate values x1.3 (88290 -> 114777 front, 121924.29 -> 158501.57 rear), damper_bump_rate/damper_rebound_rate x sqrt(1.3) = 1.1402 (damping ratio unchanged); static compression is now 0.035/1.3 = 0.02692 m, so attachment_local z is raised by 0.035 - 0.02692 = 0.008077 m (front -0.188 -> -0.179923, rear -0.171 -> -0.162923) to keep the static ride height and the chassis spawn height unchanged. No spring_preload is used. Engine thermal model (owner decision 2026-10-12): cooling_system data/cooling_systems/hyper.json (radiator sized from the heat load, see its source note) and engine_thermal data/engine_thermal/hyper_v8_one1.json; the car starts warm (engine_thermal_start warm, change it here for a cold soak). [AS] Assists (2026-10-13, physics_sim 46e0ea0): the Racing assist unit is attached (controllers entry 'assists', modes Off/On/Relaxed/Sport/Drift, default On, rear-wing automation on), mirroring physics_sim's own car_hyper files; the game no longer sets a traction-control default or drives the rear wing itself. Tyres (2026-10-13, universal tyres): no tyre files - each wheel carries a tyre_spec (compound + width/aspect/rim) that rg::load_vehicle builds in memory from data/tyres/families.json (tyre_families); a raw ps::io::load_vehicle_json of this file is rejected (physics_sim 6c5bb87: a wheel without a tyre is a load error); rg::load_vehicle injects the tyres through VehicleLoadOptions::tyres.
